critical_conclusion.action: Resolve logout revocation and assess conditional credential exposure before security acceptance.

count_rules: Characterization passes establish retained observations only.
Proposed-security failures compare draft predicates with observed behavior. They do not establish approved policy violations.

RN-S023.failure: Conflicting duplicate refresh headers for A/B result in HTTP200 and one access credential for A, rather than zero.
RN-S023.impact: An ambiguous multi-value input is accepted according to its first value in the mock servlet. Gateway normalization and organizational rejection policy remain unknown.
RN-S023.severity: UNKNOWN; proposed ambiguous-input policy needs review. Do not label demonstrated cross-account takeover.
RN-S023.origin: The selected BFF dependency receives this input; no claim of a new frontend regression.
RN-S023.action: Review duplicate-header policy and test the current HTTP/gateway path before acceptance.

RN-S035.failure: Shared Axios request to an external HTTPS fixture includes Single-UI-Authorization.
RN-S035.impact: A same-origin consumer using the public shared client for an external destination can send portal access credentials toward that destination. The fixture intercepted transport; no third party received credentials.
RN-S035.severity: S2 High conditional, analyst proposal. A supported external-destination caller and effective deployment controls remain unknown.
RN-S035.origin: Authorization-header attachment is unchanged from frontend baseline f025513f to66c6411. Existing shared-client risk.
RN-S035.action: Establish supported destination policy and caller reachability; verify that external destinations receive no portal credentials.

RN-S037.failure: A configured nonempty skip header reaches the protected synthetic SDK handler without any JWT.
RN-S037.impact: An untrusted caller that reaches a configured skip-header route can bypass JWT validation in this SDK filter fixture. Gateway stripping and real business-service reachability remain unverified.
RN-S037.severity: S2 High conditional, analyst proposal. This fixture establishes handler invocation, not unauthorized real business records.
RN-S037.origin: Current SDK dependency control flow; outside the frontend release delta. Historical baseline relationship not asserted.
RN-S037.owner: unknown SDK, gateway, and security owners
RN-S037.action: Verify trusted gateway header stripping and route isolation. Reject forged public skip headers through the actual composed service.

characterization_risks.observation: Logout returns success without persistent revocation; retained refresh then issues access.
characterization_risks.impact: A retained refresh credential can renew the session after the user believes logout completed.
characterization_risks.severity: S2 High, conditional production exposure; analyst proposal.
characterization_risks.action: Verify durable revocation and refresh replay rejection on every supported logout path.
characterization_risks.limits: Actual current controller with mocked persistence; target reachability and frequency remain unknown.

characterization_risks.observation: Old replaced refresh remains usable. Correctly signed refresh without expiry is accepted.
characterization_risks.impact: Retained signed credentials can remain usable under the observed rules.
characterization_risks.severity: Unrated policy question; single-use and required-expiry policy remain unresolved.
characterization_risks.action: Review rotation and mandatory-claim rules before acceptance.
characterization_risks.limits: No signing-key compromise or production credential issuance is demonstrated.

characterization_risks.observation: Direct B access replacement retains A refresh and visible A identity; relogin restores A.
characterization_risks.impact: A caller using this direct replacement path can return to the previous account.
characterization_risks.severity: S2 High conditional; supported direct-dispatch caller remains unknown.
characterization_risks.action: Establish caller reachability and require account-consistent replacement.

characterization_risks.observation: Rejected B login preserves A access and user but clears A refresh.
characterization_risks.impact: A can lose refresh-based recovery after the current access credential expires.
characterization_risks.severity: S3 Medium conditional; earlier refresh reacquisition can avoid this outcome.
characterization_risks.action: Verify the supported account-switch failure contract.

characterization_risks.observation: Actual console arguments contain the synthetic access canary after acquisition failure.
characterization_risks.impact: A diagnostic collector that exports these arguments could expose access credentials.
characterization_risks.severity: S2 High conditional; no exporter or recipient is demonstrated.
characterization_risks.action: Provide the diagnostic export path and verify sanitization.

characterization_risks.observation: An authorized same-origin script reads stored access, public refresh, and request configuration.
characterization_risks.impact: Same-origin script execution has access to these credential locations.
characterization_risks.severity: Architecture review required; no injection vulnerability or theft is demonstrated.
characterization_risks.action: Review credential storage and actual injection controls.
